about: Toy headless F ecology (research/body-plans/prototype/f_ecology.py). Times are medians over seeds; None = reached in <= half the seeds within T. demo_s = 25 s (eco start) + sim_s/speed. F's ecology ticks at 20 Hz, so speed xK = 20K ticks per real second.

ledger_variant_test.note: open mode, cap 3000, mut x2.5, dup on, T 1200; coefficients overridden as listed. Variant (0.05,0.15,0.15) is the recommended tuning.

dt_check.note: rhino cap1000 open(mut2.5)/guided(pull .25), dt 0.05 (F 20 Hz) vs 0.25 (toy 4 Hz), T 600

round2.about: Hybrid engine: open-ended F + sigma x2.5 always on + round-1 plate/dissolution fix + 7 body basins (canalization in develop, kappa on look genes only, top-3 affinity basins active) + niche partitioning (ground / liquid / aerial Spark / canopy / stone dens) + notes/02 biology changes. T = 1300 sim-s = demo 150 s on the hybrid schedule. demo_hybrid = x1 to 2:00 then x40; demo_x3 = constant x3 from eco start (0:25).
